title: Rates in N and the BB2 item-5 bracket
caption: Presentation only; no admission weight. (a) Against the box size N (log scale): the BB1 locality rate C q^(N−1) (C≈8.9051×10⁻⁷, q=1/64), the BB2 whole-sequence bound C′ q^(N−1) (C′=4/984375) and the BB2 item-5 bracket C_dyn/(r_N-1) + c'_site |Lambda_{r_N}| e^{|Lambda_{r_N}|/10^8} q^(N-r_N) + 2C' q^(N-1) with C_dyn=78057/622883200000000 and c′_site=2/984375, drawn as a log-space float preview of the recorded constants. The certified O(1/N) range 5≤N≤14000 is shaded; the bracket stays below 2 through N=14418 and is at least 2 (vacuous) from N=14419, where the preview reproduces the recorded first exceedance. (b) Zoom on 14388≤N≤14431: the region term overtakes the dynamics term and alternates with the parity of N through r_N=⌊(N−1)/2⌋.

title: BD1 transfer ledger across gauge groups
caption: Presentation only; no admission weight. For G in {SU(2), SU(3), SU(4), SU(5), U(1), Z2, SO(3)}: the central element acting as −1 on the Wilson representation (if any), the Haar moments E[W²] and E[W³], the exact first-order coefficient of ω(W)/τ (SU(2) 1/144, SU(3) 1/1152, SU(4) 1/2880, SU(5) 1/5760, U(1) 1/96, Z2 1/48, SO(3) 1/864), and the ledger status of the link-flip lemma (transfers: SU(2), SU(4), U(1), Z2) and of the first-order parity theorem (transfers: SU(2), SU(4), SU(5), U(1), Z2); every obstruction cell shows its exact nonzero coefficient. Statements about one-plaquette finite graphs and group box models, not AM2 or continuum statements for other groups.
